avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits platelet aggregation and may potentiate anticoagulant effect
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue or avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on bleeding risk

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (high-dose supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits platelet aggregation and prolongs bleeding time
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; monitor for increased bleeding

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit platelet aggregation and increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Counsel patient to avoid or use with caution; monitor INR equivalents if applicable

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce P-glycoprotein, potentially reducing dabigatran levels
avoid_supplements.action: Advise against use; if necessary, monitor for reduced anticoagulant effect

avoid_supplements.name: Cranberry (high-dose supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate anticoagulant effect and increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit high-dose cranberry supplements; counsel on bleeding precautions

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (>3g/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effect may additively increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor at standard doses; advise patient to report unusual bleeding

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.action: Use with awareness; monitor for bleeding signs

avoid_foods.name: Cranberry juice (excessive intake)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May potentiate anticoagulant effect and increase bleeding risk
avoid_foods.action: Advise patient to limit cranberry juice to moderate amounts or avoid

caution_foods.name: Leafy greens (spinach, kale, broccoli)
caution_foods.mechanism: High vitamin K content has minimal impact on dabigatran (unlike warfarin); consistency is key
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake; dabigatran is not vitamin K-dependent but consistency promotes stable levels

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>2 drinks/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive alcohol may increase bleeding risk and affect hemostasis
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit alcohol to moderate amounts; monitor for bleeding

monitoring_notes: Dabigatran has minimal hepatic metabolism and is primarily a P-gp substrate, reducing interaction potential compared to other DOACs. Monitor for signs of bleeding (unusual bruising, blood in urine/stool, nosebleeds) and educate patients that unlike warfarin, dabigatran does not require dietary vitamin K restriction.
